instruction_covers: async validate fails because _session is created only in __aenter__
working example is async with validator: await validator.validate(...)
notes: Repo __aenter__ creates ClientSession and returns None; __aexit__ already closes and clears _session (R3 preservation tests pass without a code change). The reported example does not use 'as v', so returning self is not required to fix the stated AttributeError. Returning self is the normal context-manager convention, so guessable rather than not_inferable: a minimal fix that only documents or keeps the no-as form still fails the new tests.
